summary:
Accepted user decision: the trusted Home route can retain a verified committed export after retiring the original source filesystem; it does not require preservation of old device/inode/owner identity. Home is the trusted local execution owner, so a separate privileged reader, signing key or production reader attestation is not a prerequisite for this route. This does not promise protection against compromised Home or weaken unrelated profiles. Home supplies the machine/provider proposal; the coordinator owns protected workflow/source integration. Keep the same original context, journal/key and CAS. Quiesce before copy and commit exact retained observation bytes before removal. Read never grants cleanup; only the first successful BeginCleanup reply supplies a consumed permission. Lost replies and expired windows do not grant replay. Explicit finite cleanup-only recovery binds the same original and committed export to current resource observations; it neither renews useful work nor recopies. Image manifest/repository references and configuration IDs require actual metadata mapping, not equal digest tails. Dedicated-runner source was delivered by Coordination PR1063 at a6196dc3. Its16GiB reference does not replace actual14GiB available-memory/80GiB free-space gates, supported capacity/write-domain enforcement, authenticated input closure or physical lifecycle and disposal proofs. Source delivery and scoped tests are distinct from provisioning, installed Home/runtime acceptance, publication/adoption and separate two-machine qualification. Original outcomes, first causes and historical Unknowns remain at their actual scope. Consult live owning issues for operational status; this record carries no runtime admission.

The27October first-path decision freezes one minimal contract and one failing actual-production-main test, including input/timer/output guards. Root selects PID1-owned allocation before descendants, complete role/complement accounting and genuine Guest phase identities separate from Host authentication. Quiesced/detached Guest output becomes an exclusive Host read-only view; actual facts materialize the context without renewed clocks. Retained archive custody remains accounted after VM cleanup. A new journal source successor is not reconstructed history. Raw cross-child kernel substitution requires a bounded source harness that executes actual guards and payload; missing assembly remains source work. Full BAR/image, dedicated-runner, reboot/two-machine, publication/adoption and recovery promises remain later applicable acceptance. Native capacity/capability/input joins stay unknown until independently qualified. Live issues retain current status; this knowledge grants no operation.

Development replay reuses only hash-bound immutable inputs/source/artifacts with contract versions, prerequisites and explicit executed stages; a historical input reference is not executed-byte evidence. Live processes, reservations, clocks, leases and cleanup facts are fresh. Periodic and final fresh production-entrypoint runs remain mandatory. Closed pure-data batches retain all charges, identity/byte/custody checks and full validation before pins or permission escape; live admission facts are never cached. Explicit bounded VM pipes need actual EOF and complete holder/group/cgroup settlement independent of PID1 terminal status, with terminal custody retained and VM stop/drain/outside-wait fitting the original controller cutoff. The keeper may remain accounted with archive-held custody after VM cleanup. An exact outside collector may outlive retiring Root only within its authenticated provider envelope and its own earlier cutoff; ordinary Root roles/arbitrary scopes gain no extension. Actual work/TERM/KILL/return joins refuse incompatible clocks. Source receiving identities remain separate from controlled Guest facts; cross-exec raw views preserve unchanged entrypoints, Guest permissions and the original deadline. These accepted decisions do not establish a working complete candidate, native capacity/API qualification or measured savings.
title: Trusted Home commits exports and supplies the dedicated qualification target
